title: Mango Avakaya Pickle
body_html:
✨ Top Highlights

A legendary Andhra delicacy made from hand-cut raw mangoes, stone-ground mustard, fiery red chillies, and slow-blended in cold-pressed oil. Bold, spicy, tangy, and deeply aromatic — Avakaya in its most authentic, heritage-rich form.

🌶️ Key Highlights

✔ Rich in natural antioxidants & digestive spices
✔ Iconic spicy-tangy flavour of Andhra cuisine
✔ Made with cold-pressed oil for superior taste & preservation
✔ 100% traditional recipe — intense, aromatic, and addictive
✔ Pairs perfectly with rice, ghee, curd rice, rotis & dosas

🫙 Storage Instructions

Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
Always use a clean, dry spoon
Refrigerate after opening for longer freshness

⏳ Shelf Life

Best before: 3 months from date of packing
(Refrigeration recommended after opening)

🌟 What Makes SAKYA Farms’ Avakaya Special?

Our Avakaya is prepared using hand-selected sour mangoes harvested at peak maturity, blended with freshly ground mustard and premium red chillies. Slow-mixed in cold-pressed sesame oil and naturally matured, this pickle follows age-old Andhra methods — no shortcuts, no artificial additives, only patience and purity.

Every batch is crafted to deliver the perfect balance of heat, tang, and aroma — just like homemade.

title: Cold Pressed Mustard Oil
body_html:
Cold-pressed mustard oil is bold, aromatic and rich in natural compounds that support heart health, digestion and metabolism, while adding depth and authenticity to every dish.

What is Mustard?

Mustard seeds come from the mustard plant — a hardy crop known for its pungent aroma and strong health profile. When cold-pressed, these tiny seeds yield mustard oil, valued for its robust flavour, high heat resistance, and beneficial fatty acids that support overall wellness.

What Distinguishes SAKYA Farms’ Mustard Oil?

We source mustard seeds from the northern regions of India, known for their climate and soil ideal for mustard cultivation. The seeds are cold-pressed without heat or chemicals, preserving natural nutrients, antioxidants and flavour. This results in an oil that is pure, aromatic, nutritionally richer and far superior to refined alternatives — crafted for traditional cooking, wellness and daily nourishment.

What is the shelf life?

It is best before 6 months from the date of packing.

title: Cold Pressed Sesame Oil
body_html:
Cold-pressed sesame oil is a delicate, nutrient-rich oil that supports heart health, nourishes skin and hair, and lends a rich, nutty depth to everyday cooking and gourmet recipes.

What is Sesame?

Sesame seeds are tiny, oil-rich kernels harvested from the sesame plant. When gently cold-pressed, they yield sesame oil — renowned for its distinctive aroma, balanced healthy fats, and traditional use in nutritious cooking across cultures.

What Distinguishes SAKYA Farms’ Sesame Oil?

Sourced from the fertile sesame belts of Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh and Tamil Nadu, our seeds are procured directly from trusted growers and cold-pressed without heat or chemicals. This gentle extraction protects natural nutrients, antioxidants and the seed’s authentic nutty aroma — yielding an oil that is pure, aromatic and nutritionally superior to refined varieties, perfect for wholesome, flavour-rich cooking.

title: A2 Cow Ghee
body_html:
Favourite A2 Ghee from desi cow milk using bilona method. Boosts focus, reduces inflammation, and nourishes your body with purity and comfort.

What is the True Essence of “Cultured”?

Cultured ghee is made by fermenting milk into curd, churning it to butter, and gently clarifying it for richer flavour and superior digestibility.


What Distinguishes SAKYA Farms’ Cultured Ghee?

Our ghee begins with contented, free-grazing indigenous cows nourished on natural pasture and milked only after the calf is fed — honouring life, purity and balance. Made traditionally in iron kadhais over firewood and sun-dried cow-dung cake, it is slow-crafted from naturally cultured curd, hand-churned to fresh white butter and gently clarified to perfection.

Not mere ghee — but heritage, integrity and nourishment in its purest form.

title: Honey
body_html:
Our Natural Approach

Our forest honey is sourced raw from the Western Ghats and kept as close to nature as possible.
To ensure purity and stability, we use a gentle hot water process only to remove excess moisture and natural wax, without adding anything or using chemicals

What Distinguishes 'SAKYA Farms’ Honey?
